title: Constrained parser monkeytest and gated fallback scenarios for streaming structured-json
creator: Marco Chen
description: Motivation: We have intermittent production incidents where streaming responses that interleave function/tool calls with partial JSON fragments cause downstream decoders to either drop fields or hang. This ticket scopes a randomized stress (monkey) test suite plus a set of gated fallback scenarios to validate and harden the constrained decoder path and schema-adherence layers.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic monkeytest harness that can exercise 10k randomized partial-stream scenarios within CI in <45m
Clear pass/fail signal: violations are schema non-adherence, unhandled parse exceptions, or decoder hangs beyond 2s per request
Gated fallback behavior implemented: on constrained-decoder failure, runtime should substitute configured compatible model variant and emit structured telemetry
Playbook entries added for triage (where to find failing examples, repro steps, and rollback toggles)
test_plan: Create a corpus of 50 canonical schemas and edge-case prompt templates (nested arrays, optional fields, polymorphic unions)
Monkeytest engine generates: token truncation mid-key, toolcall tokens inserted mid-object, KV-cache restarts, and partial JSON punctuation corruption
Run tests across 3 model families and 2 quantization profiles; collect per-token decoder traces and schema assertion failures
Add canary CI job that runs reduced (~1k) monkeytest cases on every runtime change and full suite nightly
Verify telemetry records: model_used, fallback_triggered, failure_reason, example_id, and snapshot link
implementation_notes: Leverage existing stream-reassembly util but add a 'fuzzed-tokenizer' shim to produce misaligned token boundaries
Extend schema-gate to support soft-fallback thresholds (e.g., allow 85% schema coverage -> warn, <85% -> trigger fallback)
Implement a compact failure snapshot blob (max 256KB) to store example prompt, model response, and decoder trace for triage
Expose a feature flag (feature.gated_fallbacks.streaming_parser) to enable/disable in staging and production
Add unit tests for the gated-fallback decision tree and end-to-end integration tests that exercise model substitution
rollback_plan: If the new gated fallback causes regressions, flip feature.gated_fallbacks.streaming_parser=false and revert the runtime routing change in release runtime-1.22. Run a smoke test against the basic structured-output flows before re-enable.
